title: Design System: Mountain Culture Guitar Lessons

display.purpose: Section headlines, 900 weight, white on dark / charcoal on light.

display-light.purpose: Hero masthead connective words ("Turn", "Into A"), thin 300 weight against the heavy emphasis word.

brush.purpose: One hand-marked hero word only, carried over from the prior identity.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation, dark or light.

shadows.name: card-featured
shadows.purpose: The one featured card per section, paired with a thick amber border.

shadows.name: hero-ambient-amber
shadows.purpose: Hero-only ambient backlight, confirmed exception to the No-Glow default.

motion.name: status-ping
motion.purpose: Marks a real, currently-true status (accepting students now) -- never a fabricated live feed. Hero only.

motion.name: sparkle-twinkle
motion.purpose: Decorative hero flourish, SVG not emoji.

components.name: Primary Button (Amber)
components.description: Solid amber pill button, dark text -- the system's one accent, used on both dark and light sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F59E0B; color: #0F172A; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 13px; padding: 16px 36px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D97706; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Card surface for dark sections (hero, pricing, locations).
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: #1E293B; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; color: #fff; }

components.name: Light Card
components.description: Card surface for light sections (features, reviews).
components.css: .ds-card-light { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; color: #0F172A; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

components.name: Trust Banner Pill
components.css: .ds-trust-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #1E293B; border: 1px solid #334155; color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.northStar: The Night Studio, Lit by One Warm Lamp
narrative.overview: The page alternates dark and light sections like a studio at night: the hero, pricing, and locations sections go dark-slate with a single warm amber accent doing all the signaling, while Why Us and testimonials stay crisp and bright for readability and relief. Dark sections hold the decisions that matter most; light sections hold the proof and explanation. Trust is built through specificity -- a real map, real stats, real testimonials -- not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Strict section-level alternation: Hero (dark), Why Us (light), Pricing (dark), Locations (dark), Reviews (light), Footer (dark)
One accent color (amber) carries every CTA and highlight across both dark and light sections
Dark sections use dark-card surfaces with thin borders, never pure black-on-black
Light sections use true white cards on an off-white ground
The hero carries a confirmed, bounded set of glow/motion accents not used elsewhere

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the system's only accent color, on both dark and light sections.

rules.name: The Hero-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow, gradient rings, and sparkle accents are a confirmed hero flourish, not a system-wide depth cue.

rules.name: The Honest-Pulse Rule
rules.body: The hero's status-badge pulse marks a real, currently-true state, never a fabricated live-updating feed.

dos: Do keep amber as the system's only accent color across every section.
Do keep the dark/light alternation strict and literal.
Do keep the hero's glow/pulse/sparkle accents bounded to the hero.
Do state only confirmed facts in the trust banner.
Do keep the map embed scoped to the area with a real studio.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue competing with amber.
Don't soften the hard cut between dark and light sections with a gradient transition.
Don't stack two bordered/backgrounded containers inside each other for ordinary content.
Don't animate a status indicator to suggest a live feed when the fact is just true/false.
